args: require HTTP::Tiny; my $r = HTTP::Tiny->new(timeout => 15)->get('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD'); die "Fetch failed: $r->{status} $r->{reason}\n" unless $r->{success}; $_ = JSON::XS::decode_json($r->{content}); die "Invalid exchange-rate response\n" unless $_->{result} eq 'success' && ref($_->{rates}) eq 'HASH' && $_->{rates}{USD} == 1;
